Name: Less Ugly Adventurers Guild
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[size=5][u][b][i]Less Ugly Adventurers Guild[/i][/b][/u][/size]

[size=3]A very simple mod with an [s]unusually long description.[/s] Nay, It's pretty short today my friend :)[/size]
[size=3]
[b]Guild Empty

Me make messy

Guild not empty

ooga booga

[/b]Meh, not my proudest edit but I just want to get it over it so what the hell.[/size]

[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size][size=5]
[b][color=#ff0000]
[u][i]Very Important, Read me![/i][/u][/color][/b][/size]

[size=5]What this mod [/size][b][color=#ff0000][u][size=5][i]DOESN'T[/i][/size][/u][i] [/i][/color][/b][size=5]do:[/size]

[size=4][b]1. Eh
[/b]Eh[/size]

[size=4][b][s]2. Edits the Heart events[/s][/b]
[/size][size=3]Might I remind you, Marlon and Gil is but a false human. They exist simply to take up atoms and say a few predetermined lines. How do they have heart events if they do not have a living heart?

[/size][size=4][b]3. My cat puked while I type this[/b]
[/size][size=3]Help me Yoba it is way too early for this
[/size]

[size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=4][u][b]East Scarp[/b][/u][/size][/color][size=4], I doubt that they add a cutscene of sort in the Guild, so it should be okay :p[/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=4]eyes up there bub ^[/size]
[u][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], meow.[/size][size=4]
[b][color=#ff7700][u]Marlon/Gil [/u][u]Expansions[/u][/color][/b], unsure.
[/size]
[size=3][b]Regarding ES & RSV[/b], If I'm mistaken and they do add a cutscene, worst that can happen is either your farmer walking infinitely into some furniture or the npcs not being to complete the scene. Install No-clip or simply skip the cutscene :)
[b]Regarding Marlon/Gil Expansions[/b], Maybe. Just test it out and see. More detailed info is that it depends on how the mod patches the guild.
[b]Regarding SVE[/b], We've been trying to reach you concerning your vehicles extended warran-[/size]

[u][size=5][b][i]Installation[/i][/b]

2. Download this mod
3. Extract the zip into your mods folder 
4. Viola![/size]
